This License will therefore apply, along with any applicable section 7 additional terms, to the whole of the work, and all its parts, regardless of how they are packaged. This License gives no permission to license the work in any other way, but it does not invalidate such permission if you have separately received it.
d) If the work has interactive user interfaces, each must display Appropriate Legal Notices; however, if the Program has interactive interfaces that do not display Appropriate Legal Notices, your work need not make them do so.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §5; applies to conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form. The interface notice condition has the stated exception.

rules.source_excerpt: You may convey a covered work in object code form under the terms of sections 4 and 5, provided that you also convey the machine-readable Corresponding Source under the terms of this License, in one of these ways:
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; object-code conveyance requires machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License through one applicable alternative in §6(a)–(e).
rules.condition_explanation: The §4 and §5 conditions apply as relevant. The source methods in §6(a)–(e) are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

obligation_items.content: Convey the machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License by one applicable method in §6(a)–(e).
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for the object-code covered work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a covered work in object-code form, in addition to applicable §4 and §5 conditions.

rules.source_excerpt: a) Convey the object code in, or embodied in, a physical product (including a physical distribution medium), accompanied by the Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(a); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement.
rules.condition_explanation: This is one alternative among §6(a)–(e), not an additional cumulative condition.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code with Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
obligation_items.object: object code and its Corresponding Source
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(a).

rules.source_excerpt: b) Convey the object code in, or embodied in, a physical product (including a physical distribution medium), accompanied by a written offer, valid for at least three years and valid for as long as you offer spare parts or customer support for that product model, to give anyone who possesses the object code either (1) a copy of the Corresponding Source for all the software in the product that is covered by this License, on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange, for a price no more than your reasonable cost of physically performing this conveying of source, or (2) access to copy the Corresponding Source from a network server at no charge.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(b); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement. The offer provides either a physical source copy at no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost or no-charge network access to copy source.
rules.condition_explanation: The written offer is for anyone possessing the object code. It must remain valid for at least three years and as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model. The price cap applies to the physical-copy option.

obligation_items.content: Provide a written offer to give any possessor of the object code either a Corresponding Source copy on a customary durable physical medium for no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost, or no-charge network access to copy it.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for all software in the product covered by the License
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(b).

obligation_items.content: Keep the written offer valid for at least three years and for as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model.
obligation_items.object: written source offer for the product model
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using §6(b).

rules.source_excerpt: c) Convey individual copies of the object code with a copy of the written offer to provide the Corresponding Source. This alternative is allowed only occasionally and noncommercially, and only if you received the object code with such an offer, in accord with subsection 6b.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(c); limited alternative for conveying individual object-code copies with the written offer.
rules.condition_explanation: Conveyance must be both occasional and noncommercial, and the actor must have received the object code with an offer in accordance with §6(b).

rules.source_excerpt: d) Convey the object code by offering access from a designated place (gratis or for a charge), and offer equivalent access to the Corresponding Source in the same way through the same place at no further charge. You need not require recipients to copy the Corresponding Source along with the object code. If the place to copy the object code is a network server, the Corresponding Source may be on a different server (operated by you or a third party) that supports equivalent copying facilities, provided you maintain clear directions next to the object code saying where to find the Corresponding Source. Regardless of what server hosts the Corresponding Source, you remain obligated to ensure that it is available for as long as needed to satisfy these requirements.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(d); object-code access may be gratis or for a charge. Source may be hosted on a different server if it supports equivalent copying facilities; recipients need not be required to copy source with object code.
rules.condition_explanation: Equivalent source access must be through the same place and in the same way, with no further charge. Clear directions are required if object code is offered from a network server. The source-availability duty applies regardless of hosting server.

obligation_items.content: Offer equivalent access to Corresponding Source through the same place and in the same way as object-code access, at no further charge.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code by offering access from a designated place.

obligation_items.content: Place clear directions next to the object code stating where to find Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.trigger: When the place to copy object code is a network server.

obligation_items.content: Ensure Corresponding Source remains available for as long as needed to satisfy the source-conveyance requirements.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using §6(d), regardless of which server hosts the source.

rules.source_excerpt: e) Convey the object code using peer-to-peer transmission, provided you inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source of the work are being offered to the general public at no charge under subsection 6d.

obligation_items.content: Inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under §6(d).

rules.source_excerpt: If you convey an object code work under this section in, or with, or specifically for use in, a User Product, and the conveying occurs as part of a transaction in which the right of possession and use of the User Product is transferred to the recipient in perpetuity or for a fixed term (regardless of how the transaction is characterized), the Corresponding Source conveyed under this section must be accompanied by the Installation Information. But this requirement does not apply if neither you nor any third party retains the ability to install modified object code on the User Product (for example, the work has been installed in ROM).
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; when the stated User Product transaction conditions apply, Installation Information must accompany Corresponding Source unless neither the conveyor nor any third party can install modified object code on the product.
rules.condition_explanation: Applicability requires conveyance under §6, the specified relationship to a User Product, and transfer of possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term. The two alternatives are: provide Installation Information, or the stated inability of either the conveyor or any third party to install modified object code.

obligation_items.content: Accompany Corresponding Source with Installation Information sufficient to install and execute modified versions from modified Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code under §6 in, with, or specifically for a User Product in a transaction transferring possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term, unless neither the conveyor nor any third party retains the ability to install modified object code on the product.

rules.source_excerpt: The requirement to provide Installation Information does not include a requirement to continue to provide support service, warranty, or updates for a work that has been modified or installed by the recipient, or for the User Product in which it has been modified or installed. Access to a network may be denied when the modification itself materially and adversely affects the operation of the network or violates the rules and protocols for communication across the network.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; Installation Information does not require continuing support, warranty, or updates for a work or User Product modified or installed by the recipient. Network access may be denied on the stated grounds.
rules.condition_explanation: The no-continuing-service statement limits the Installation Information requirement. The stated access-denial grounds require that the modification itself materially and adversely affects network operation or violates network communication rules and protocols.

rules.source_excerpt: Corresponding Source conveyed, and Installation Information provided, in accord with this section must be in a format that is publicly documented (and with an implementation available to the public in source code form), and must require no special password or key for unpacking, reading or copying.
rules.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; applies to Corresponding Source conveyed and Installation Information provided under that section.
rules.condition_explanation: The format must be publicly documented, have an implementation available publicly in source-code form, and require no special password or key for unpacking, reading, or copying.

obligation_items.content: Provide Corresponding Source and Installation Information in a publicly documented format with an implementation available to the public in source-code form, requiring no special password or key to unpack, read, or copy.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying Corresponding Source or providing Installation Information under §6.
